title: Haro Turtles
description: Replaces the Turtles from CC: Tweaked with Haros from Mobile Suit Gundam.
body:
### Haro Turtles

Have you ever wanted your turtle helpers to look like Haros? Then this is the perfect resource pack for you!

![Spread of all Haro colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ca89e2dd82b392c78ba74ac124fa247cc6e5a1e.png)

This pack includes any haro color you'd want, as well as the classic Green Haro and a Special Purple Haro for the Basic and Advanced Turtles respectively!
